'''A New Hope''' is the 5th expansion of Star Wars CCG.
It is published by Decipher 1996 and consists of 162 cards. This expansion was available in 15-card boosters.

'''A New Hope''' is the 1st expansion of Star Wars CCG (CardGuide numbering: 5th product).



Important debuts included Chewbacca and R2-D2, the Death Star as a system card, creatures, and a mechanic that allowed for the destruction of entire planets. Other languages on CardGuide: JP.
